title: A Sharp Dynamic Haussler Lemma
abstract: arXiv:2610.29898v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Haussler's covering lemma (JCTA 1995) gives the sharp $(C/\delta)^d$ metric-entropy bound for binary VC classes under normalized $\ell_1$ distance. We prove a sharp global dynamic analogue for bounded real-valued classes in normalized $\ell_p$, for every $1\le p<\infty$. Writing $d=\operatorname{sfat}_{\varepsilon/32}(\mathcal F)$, we obtain a global dynamic cover of size at most $(C/\varepsilon^p)^d$ for every horizon and $0<\varepsilon<1/2$. Here a single family of deterministic causal experts, fixed independently of the instance sequence, covers every target on every sequence. For $0<\varepsilon<1/4$, a matching worst-case lower bound $(c/\varepsilon)^{pd}$ holds already for binary classes on one fixed sequence, even with real-valued experts. The constants are universal, independent of $p$.   For $p=2$, this resolves the horizon-independent sequential $\ell_2$ covering problem of Rakhlin, Sridharan, and Tewari (PTRF 2015) in a stronge

translated_title: 一个紧致的动态 Haussler 引理
translated_abstract: Haussler 覆盖引理（JCTA 1995）给出了二值 VC 类在归一化 ℓ₁ 距离下紧致的 (C/δ)^d 度量熵界。我们证明了它在归一化 ℓ_p 距离下、针对有界实值函数类（对每个 1≤p<∞）的紧致全局动态类似结果。记 d=sfat_{ε/32}(F)（序列 fat 维数），我们对任意时间范围以及 0<ε<1/2 得到规模至多为 (C/ε^p)^d 的全局动态覆盖。这里，仅由一族确定性的因果专家组成、且独立于实例序列事先固定的单个家族，即可在每条序列上覆盖每个目标。对于 0<ε<1/4，匹配的最坏情形下界 (c/ε)^{pd} 已经在一条固定序列上的二值类情形下成立，即使使用实值专家也是如此。其中的常数是普适的，与 p 无关。当 p=2 时，该结果以强形式解决了 Rakhlin、Sridharan 和 Tewari（PTRF 2015）提出的与时间范围无关的序贯 ℓ₂ 覆盖问题……
tldr: 本文将 Haussler 覆盖引理推广到序贯设定：对归一化 ℓ_p（1≤p<∞）中的有界实值类，存在与时间范围无关、规模为 (C/ε^p)^d 的全局动态覆盖（d 为序列 fat 维数），并给出匹配的下界，从而在 p=2 时解决了 Rakhlin 等人提出的序贯 ℓ₂ 覆盖问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proves a sharp dynamic analogue of Haussler's covering lemma: for bounded real-valued classes in normalized ℓ_p (1≤p<∞), a global dynamic cover of size (C/ε^p)^d exists for every horizon with a matching lower bound, resolving the horizon-independent sequential ℓ₂ covering problem of Rakhlin, Sridharan, and Tewari.
